method.thesis: Native Bun reduces startup/build overhead for existing pure unit contracts; measure other migrated categories without presuming improvement.
method.primary: warm CLI wall time for the identical six provider files / 26 selected tests
method.worthwhile_delta: 10% median reduction; report variance and regressions, no full-suite or CI extrapolation
method.guardrails: identical selected test identities/counts; no test failures, runtime skips, or retries; same machine/runtimes/browser/context and one shared built app for E2E
method.method: three warmups per runner, then five alternating before/after pairs for each category; two isolated workers for units/DOM and one for app E2E; CI=1 TZ=UTC
method.limits: macOS local warm caches; shared app startup excluded from E2E runner timing; not Linux, cold install, full suite, or CI speed evidence
method.e2e_amendment_before_measurement: Host ports 55012/55013 became occupied by an unrelated Docker workload. Share one candidate static app on 55535 for both runners; retain search plus Escape/scroll-state restoration journeys, two unchanged existing cases, one worker. No Connect-dependent case in benchmark. Full E2E verification still uses original application/Connect endpoints.

identity_normalization: Rstest uses comma-joined array parameters while Bun renders JSON arrays; normalized only the unchanged conversion-validation path parameters.
Playwright JSON uses paths relative to testDir; normalized those to repository-relative e2e paths.
